title: 20-Year Treasury Bond auction (November new issue) — the quarterly new-issue slot, sized by the 11-12 announcement, bidding one hour before the FOMC minutes
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-08 for this initial research (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream — an independent second read of the same primary the proposing sweep used. Row reads verbatim `20-Year BOND / Announcement Thursday, November 12, 2026 / Auction Wednesday, November 18, 2026 / Settlement Monday, November 30, 2026` — the ABSENCE of Treasury's trailing `R` reopening marker is what makes this a NEW ISSUE, and the same fetch shows `20-Year BONDR` on the September, October, December and January rows for contrast. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-11-12 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE written 2026-09-08 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, promoting the single proposal that existed for this id (proposals/treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18.from-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12.json, read in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md). THE FINDING THAT EARNED THE TITLE CHANGE: this is the only slot in the 20-Year complex that systematically bids into a second 2:00pm ET Fed release. Cross-referencing federalreserve.gov's own FOMC calendar (fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200, its 30 published `(Released ...)` minutes dates) against fiscaldata `auctions_query` (all 44 20-Year auctions since 2023-01-01, same-day pull) gives 9 of 15 NEW ISSUES landing on an FOMC-minutes day and 0 of 29 REOPENINGS — 9 of the last 11 new issues since 2024-02. 2026-11-18 is the tenth, and unlike the base rate it is CONFIRMED on both legs: fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 is `confirmed`/`FED:` at 2:00pm ET (Oct 27-28 meeting + 21 days), one hour after this auction's 1:00pm bid deadline, with tic-monthly-2026-11-18 at 4:00pm behind it. Consequence recorded here because it governs how the print is read: the day's close-to-close yield move is a JOINT observation and cannot be attributed to the auction. GRADING YARDSTICK, new-issue slot only (n=15): floor 2.34, p25 2.41, median 2.53, p75 2.55, ceiling 2.58 — the sibling treasury-20y-bond-2026-10-21 ledger's 2.60 reopening threshold sits ABOVE every 20Y new issue ever printed and must not be carried across. Composition, the second dimension: direct-bidder share on the competitive base is >=22.9% in the last five new issues and <=20.2% in the prior ten. EXPECTED SIZE $16B on a 13-consecutive-new-issue grid at that number since 2023-08-23, published 2026-11-04 and restated 2026-11-12 — already owned and scored by FT-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12-1 and deliberately NOT re-registered here. PREDECESSOR CUSIP 912810UX4 (new issue 2026-08-19, $16B, high yield 5.204%, bid-to-cover 2.53), whose own session is confounded twice over — minutes day AND the sb0607 buyback-doubling announcement. That doubled long-end buyback window expires 2026-11-04 by its own terms, so this is the first long-end coupon sale under whatever regime the November refunding sets. Settlement 2026-11-30 is month-end rather than mid-month, shared with the 10-Year TIPS reopening the next day. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed.
